`native_set_programmer_art`).
doc_summary: client hooks and state for PvP client mods. View: `native_hurt_tilt` (hurt camera tilt), `native_fire_overlay` (first-person fire lower), `native_hand_pose`/`native_item_pose` (first-person item placement and pose, drawing only), `native_camera_rotation` with `native_turn` (a camera that turns apart from the player: freelook), `native_seen_weather`/`native_seen_day_time` (weather and time as the player sees them; the world's own are unchanged), `native_hit_color`/`native_glint_color` (hurt flash and glint colours), `native_lines` (world lines, as F3+B's) and `native_sidebar_place` (move and scale the scoreboard sidebar). Input and events: `native_movement_keys` (sprint and sneak as held), `native_attack_reach`, `native_player_attacked`, `native_mob_died`. Helpers read the attack cooldown, food, effects, equipment, carried counts, item cooldowns, nearby entities' boxes (`native_entity` by index), the crosshair's target and a world point's place on the HUD (`native_project`), and set fullbright and the chat backdrop for a frame, spawn local particles, draw a stack with its components (`native_stack`), set the F5 view and turn Programmer Art on or off. Bundles need "hooks": @API:incari_client_hooks@.
